definitionZh: 树视图小部件呈现分层列表。层次结构中的任何项目都可以具有子项目，并且具有子项目的项目可以展开或折叠以显示或隐藏子项目。例如，在使用树视图显示文件夹和文件的文件系统导航器中，可以展开表示文件夹的项目以显示文件夹的内容，该内容可以是文件、文件夹或两者。
sourceDefinition: A tree view widget presents a hierarchical list. Any item in the hierarchy may have child items, and items that have children may be expanded or collapsed to show or hide the children. For example, in a file system navigator that uses a tree view to display folders and files, an item representing a folder can be expanded to reveal the contents of the folder, which may be files, folders, or both.
